name: cable vertical pallof press
description: A cable press performed upward or downward in a vertical line while holding the core still. It trains anti-rotation and shoulder stability.
instructions: Set a cable at a high or low position and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight up (or down) along a vertical line.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return to your chest, finish the set, then switch sides.
